verification_categories_derived_from_spe: LTSSM completeness — every state + sub-state reachable: Detect (Quiet / Active), Polling (Active / Configuration / Compliance / Speed), Configuration (Linkwidth.Start / Linkwidth.Accept / Lanenum.Wait / Lanenum.Accept / Complete / Idle), L0, L0s, L1, L2, Recovery (RcvrLock / RcvrCfg / Idle / Speed), Loopback (Entry / Master / Slave / Exit), Disabled, Hot Reset.
TLP roundtrip — each transaction type (MRd / MRdLk / MWr / IORd / IOWr / CfgRd0/1 / CfgWr0/1 / Msg / MsgD / Cpl / CplD / CplLk / CplDLk) sent + correctly handled at the Completer.
TLP 3DW header vs 4DW header — both addressing variants.
TLP with data payload at every Max_Payload_Size (128 / 256 / 512 / 1024 / 2048 / 4096 B).
ACK / NAK protocol — TLP with intact LCRC ack-ed; TLP with corrupted LCRC NAK-ed + replayed correctly.
Sequence Number wrap-around at 12-bit boundary (4096).
Replay-Buffer overflow — REPLAY_NUM rollover declares Link failed → LTSSM Recovery.
DLLP error injection — corrupted DLLP discarded; UpdateFC scheduling continues.
Flow Control initialization on VC0; per-VC (when VC1..VC7 enabled) credit advertisement and credit return via UpdateFC.
Credit-based flow control underflow detection (a fatal protocol error).
Virtual Channel — VC0 mandatory; VC1..VC7 negotiation if Capability is advertised.
Traffic Class to VC mapping — software-configurable; per-spec restrictions (TC0 must map to VC0).
Max_Payload_Size negotiation — path-wide minimum enforced; Malformed TLP error on violation.
ECRC (optional) — TD = 1 + 32-bit Digest correctly generated + verified.
Completion Timeout — programmable per Device Control Register.
Unsupported Request / Completer Abort / Configuration Retry Status Completion Status codes.
Advanced Error Reporting (AER) — Correctable / Uncorrectable Non-Fatal / Uncorrectable Fatal classes.
Switch behavior — all TLPs forwarded between any port pair; no TLP splitting; peer-to-peer between downstream ports.
Configuration enumeration — Bus / Device / Function walk; Type 0 vs Type 1 routing per spec.
PCI Express Capability Structure exposure + Link Capabilities / Device Capabilities discovery.
MSI generation — posted Memory Write to designated address.
Legacy INTx emulation via Message Requests (INTx_Assert / INTx_Deassert).
Power management — L0 → L0s → L0 within N_FTS budget; L0 → L1 → L0 via Recovery; L0 → L2 via PM_Enter_L23; L2 → Detect via Beacon.
Hot Reset — TS1 with Hot Reset bit returns downstream device to Detect.
Native Hot-Plug — card-present + power-indicator + attention-indicator + MRL-sensor + power-fault flow.
8b/10b running-disparity rule + Lane polarity inversion + Lane reversal handling.
SKP ordered set insertion every 1180-1538 symbols for ±300 ppm clock-tolerance compensation.
Compliance pattern + Loopback test modes for production-line characterization.
fields.notes: PCI Express Rev 1.0 does NOT include a formal verification testbench. The categories above are derived from Chapters 2 (TL), 3 (DLL), 4 (PHY + LTSSM), 5 (software), 6 (PM), 7 (system architecture) and Appendix A (Isochronous). The PCI-SIG Compliance Program supplies the formal compliance test suite + Compliance Workshops for interoperability validation.
